cohort: Pregnant mothers who underwent emergency caesarean delivery at a secondary health facility in north-central Nigeria between February 2017 and February 2021.
finding: Delayed decision-to-delivery interval (DDI) was associated with increased odds of perinatal deaths, SCBU admission, and maternal complications including sepsis, hypotension, and cardiac arrest.
mod_finding: A delayed decision-to-delivery interval during emergency caesarean section was associated with increased odds of perinatal deaths, SCBU admission, and maternal complications.
